description_en: Query the agent list in the Cloud Customer Service System by AICCS instance ID and skill group ID
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID查询悉犀客服工作台坐席列表
name: ListAgentBySkillGroupId

parameters.help_en: A unique ID for the Customer request. It is used for idempotency validation and can be generated using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill group ID.  
You can invoke the QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) API and view the SkillGroupId in the response parameters to obtain the skill group ID
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的SkillGroupId，即技能组ID
parameters.name: skill_group_id

Code.description_en: Status code. A return value of "Success" indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

AccountName.description_en: Account name of the agent, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance
AccountName.description_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一

Status.description_en:
Agent status. Only agents with a Normal status can perform Business Activities. Valid values:
0: Normal
1: Frozen
2: Deleted
Status.description_zh:
坐席状态。只有正常的状态，才可进行业务活动。取值：
0：正常
1：冻结
2：删除

TenantId.description_en: Tenant ID to which the agent belongs. This corresponds to the instance ID provided in the input parameter
TenantId.description_zh: 坐席所属的租户ID。与入参中的实例ID对应

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API invocation succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
